description: Use this when someone wants to know how their own customers would react to a change or idea, such as a price change, a new message or a feature: it starts a simulation of the workspace's saved personas on GatherHQ's simulation engine and waits up to about 3 minutes for the results: the summary, each persona's direction and reason, and a link. If it is still running, get the results later with gather_get_simulation. Results are simulated, not observed customer responses. Needs a workspace with GatherHQ credits; otherwise use gather_report_start, which runs simulated interviews for any company.

audience.description: b2b if the company sells to businesses, b2c to consumers.

topic.description: The change or idea as a customer would hear it, e.g. "We raise prices 20% and add a dedicated success manager".

name: gather_run_simulation
title: Simulate your personas' reaction
